title: Swim Speed Up

{{Infobox Mechanic |image= {{Media |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Swim Speed Up Icon.png |Sprite TotK= File:TotK Swim Speed Up Icon.png |Sprite EoW= File:EoW Swim Speed Up Icon.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |game= BotW, TotK, EoW |other= |purpose= |related= {{List| * [[Added Effect]] * [[Armor]] * [[Cooking]] * [[Swim Dash Stamina Up]] * [[Swimming]] }} }} {{Term/Store|Swim Speed Up||Series, BotW, TotK, EoW}} is a recurring [[Added Effect]] in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Overview== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Swim Speed Up is an [[Added Effect]] that increases [[Link]]'s [[Swimming]] speed by 30%, 60%, and 100% for levels one, two, and three respectively. The Effect has a maximum potency of level three. The following [[Armor]] pieces grant Swim Speed Up: {{Gallery List|Items |BotW= Zora Helm, Zora Armor, Zora Greaves, Vah Ruta Divine Helm, Opal Earrings, Salvager Headwear, Salvager Vest, Salvager Trousers }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== Swim Speed Up returns in {{TotK}}. Like in {{BotW}}, it increases [[Link]]'s [[Swimming]] speed by 30%, 60%, and 100% for levels one, two, and three respectively. The [[Added Effect]] has a maximum potency of level three. The following [[Material]]s grant Swim Speed Up: {{Gallery List|Items |TotK= Splash Fruit }} The following [[Armor]] pieces grant Swim Speed Up: {{Gallery List|Items |TotK= Zora Helm, Zora Armor, Zora Greaves, Vah Ruta Divine Helm, Opal Earrings }} ==={{EoW|-}}=== Swim Speed Up is an [[Added Effect]] that allows [[Zelda]] to [[Swimming|Swim]] faster. It is granted by wearing the [[Zora's Flippers]]. The Effect can also be temporarily activated by consuming [[Smoothie]]s or [[Potion]]s with "Rapid" in their names. These drinks are made using [[Riverhorse]]s. The following drinks grant Swim Speed Up when consumed by Zelda: {{Data Table |game= EoW |columns= Drink[Image][Link], Swim Speed Up Duration |- | Rapid Smoothie | 1:00 |- | Milky Rapid Smoothie | 1:00 |- | Golden Rapid Smoothie | 5:00 |- | Rapid Potion | 5:00 }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== * {{Term|Series|Added Effect|link}} * {{Term|Series|Swim Dash Stamina Up|link}} {{Ref| {{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 280|edition= Expanded Edition|year= 2018}} {{Cite Guide|TotK Piggyback|page=402-403}} {{Cite|{{Icon|EoW Swim Speed Up}} Swim Speed Up|Equipment (Interface)|EoW}} {{Cite|{{Big|{{Color EoW|Pink|Zora's Flippers}}}}
